articles.title_en: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality
articles.title_cn: Walras-Bowley讲座：市场势力与工资不平等
articles.abstract_en: We propose a theory of how market power affects wage inequality. We ask how goods and labor market power jointly determine the level of wages, the skill premium, and wage inequality. We then use detailed microdata from the U.S. Census Bureau between 1997 and 2016 to estimate the parameters of labor supply, technology, and the market structure. We find that a less competitive market structure lowers the average wage of high‐skilled workers by 11.3%, and of low‐skilled workers by 12.2%, contributes 8.1% to the rise in the skill premium, and accounts for 54.8% of the increase in between‐establishment wage variance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个关于市场势力如何影响工资不平等的理论。我们探讨商品和劳动力市场势力如何共同决定工资水平、技能溢价和工资不平等。然后，我们使用美国人口普查局1997年至2016年间的详细微观数据来估计劳动力供给、技术和市场结构的参数。我们发现，竞争性较弱的市场结构使高技能工人的平均工资降低11.3%，低技能工人的平均工资降低12.2%，对技能溢价的上升贡献了8.1%，并解释了54.8%的机构间工资方差增加。

articles.title_en: A Comment on: “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality” by Shubhdeep Deb, Jan Eeckhout, Aseem Patel, and Lawrence Warren
articles.title_cn: 对Shubhdeep Deb、Jan Eeckhout、Aseem Patel和Lawrence Warren所著《Walras–Bowley讲座：市场势力与工资不平等》的评论

articles.title_en: A Comment on: “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality” by Shubhdeep Deb, Jan Eeckhout, Aseem Patel, and Lawrence Warren
articles.title_cn: 评论：《瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：市场势力与工资不平等》作者：舒布迪普·德布、扬·埃克豪特、阿西姆·帕特尔和劳伦斯·沃伦
articles.abstract_en: A burgeoning literature in labor economics is focused on modeling employer labor market power, generally finding nontrivial estimates of monopsony power. A smaller literature also simultaneously incorporates product market power. Deb, Eeckhout, Patel, and Warren (2024) is an example of applying an oligopoly‐oligopsony model to the U.S. labor market, arguing for important effects on wage levels and inequality from rising market power. I support combining IO and labor as a fruitful way of studying wages and business dynamism, but argue for looking more broadly at (i) differential degrees of employer power in labor and product markets; (ii) investigating the dynamic sources of markups (e.g., through innovation), and (iii) considering wage bargaining models, not just wage posting models, which have some starkly different implications for wage setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动经济学中一个新兴的文献侧重于建模雇主劳动力市场势力，通常发现对垄断势力的非平凡估计。一个较小的文献也同时纳入了产品市场势力。德布、埃克豪特、帕特尔和沃伦（2024）是将寡头垄断-寡头垄断模型应用于美国劳动力市场的一个例子，认为市场势力的上升对工资水平和不平等产生了重要影响。我支持将产业组织与劳动相结合作为研究工资和企业活力的有效途径，但主张更广泛地审视（i）劳动力和产品市场中雇主势力的差异程度；（ii）研究加价的动态来源（例如，通过创新）；以及（iii）考虑工资谈判模型，而不仅仅是工资公告模型，后者对工资设定有一些截然不同的含义。

articles.title_en: Reply to: Comments on “Walras–Bowley Lecture: Market Power and Wage Inequality”
articles.title_cn: 回复：对“瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：市场势力与工资不平等”的评论
articles.abstract_en: Census Bureau VIOLANTE (2023) AND VAN REENEN (2023) offer a comprehensive review of the lecture and point out the key aspects of the paper.We are grateful for their comments which have greatly improved this research.Our goals in this paper are twofold: (a) to provide a methodological framework that jointly incorporates goods market power (oligopoly) and labor market power (oligopsony) in a general equilibrium setting, and (b) to propose an empirical strategy for applying such a framework to microdata to estimate key structural parameters and a joint distribution of establishment-level productivity.Combined, these features allow us to quantify the relative importance of technological change and changes in market structure on the labor market, in particular on the evolution of wages, wage stagnation, and wage inequality.The main insight of our model is that market power and wage inequality are both endogenous objects, determined simultaneously in equilibrium by (1) the market structure (the number of competing firms); (2) the dispersion of establishment-level productivity; and (3) the substitutability parameters in the product and labor markets.We find that a change in the market structure (excluding changes in the dispersion of productivity and within-and between-market substitutability parameters) accounts for 8.1% of the rise in the skill premium, and 54.8% of the increase in between-establishment inequality.Our analysis also establishes that technology is indeed the main driver of wage inequality, whereas the decline in competition is behind the increasing gap between wages and productivity.Both commentators rightly point out that our assumption of perfectly overlapping boundaries between product and labor markets is strong.We agree, and nonetheless maintain this simplifying assumption for two reasons.The first is for computational tractability, as allowing for non-overlapping boundaries greatly increases the dimensionality of the system of equations needed to compute the economy's equilibrium. 1 Second, we es-
articles.abstract_cn: 人口普查局维奥兰特（2023）和范里宁（2023）对讲座进行了全面回顾，并指出了论文的关键方面。我们感谢他们的评论，这些评论极大地改进了这项研究。本文的目标有两个：（a）提供一个方法论框架，在一般均衡设定中共同纳入商品市场势力（寡头垄断）和劳动力市场势力（寡头 monopsony）；（b）提出一种实证策略，将该框架应用于微观数据，以估计关键结构参数和企业层面生产率的联合分布。综合这些特征，我们能够量化技术变革和市场结构变化对劳动力市场的相对重要性，特别是对工资演变、工资停滞和工资不平等的影响。我们模型的主要见解是，市场势力和工资不平等都是内生对象，在均衡中由（1）市场结构（竞争企业数量）；（2）企业层面生产率的离散程度；以及（3）产品和劳动力市场中的替代参数同时决定。我们发现，市场结构的变化（不包括生产率离散程度以及市场内和市场间替代参数的变化）解释了技能溢价上升的8.1%，以及企业间不平等增加的54.8%。我们的分析还表明，技术确实是工资不平等的主要驱动因素，而竞争下降则是工资与生产率之间差距扩大的背后原因。两位评论者正确指出，我们关于产品和劳动力市场边界完全重叠的假设是强有力的。我们同意，但出于两个原因仍维持这一简化假设。第一个是为了计算的可处理性，因为允许非重叠边界会大大增加计算经济均衡所需方程组的维度。1 第二，我们……

articles.title_cn: 共同价值下的认证设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies certification design and its implications for information disclosure. Our model features a profit‐maximizing certifier and the seller of a good of unknown quality. We allow for common values as the seller's opportunity cost may depend on the quality of the good. We compare certifier‐optimal with transparency‐maximizing certification design. Certifier‐optimal certification design implements the evidence structure of Dye (1985)—a fraction of sellers acquire information while the remaining sellers are uninformed—and results in partial disclosure to the market. A transparency‐maximizing regulator prefers a less precise signal, which conveys more information to the market through a higher rate of certification and unraveling (Grossman (1981), Milgrom (1981)) at the disclosure stage.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究认证设计及其对信息披露的影响。我们的模型以一个追求利润最大化的认证机构和一位销售质量未知商品的卖方为特征。我们允许共同价值的存在，因为卖方的机会成本可能取决于商品的质量。我们比较了认证机构最优与透明度最大化的认证设计。认证机构最优的认证设计实现了Dye（1985）的证据结构——一部分卖方获取信息，而其余卖方不获取信息——并导致市场部分披露。透明度最大化的监管者偏好一个不那么精确的信号，该信号通过更高的认证率和披露阶段的揭穿效应（Grossman（1981），Milgrom（1981））向市场传递更多信息。

articles.title_en: Bias‐Aware Inference in Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Designs
articles.title_cn: 模糊回归不连续设计中的偏差感知推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose new confidence sets (CSs) for the regression discontinuity parameter in fuzzy designs. Our CSs are based on local linear regression, and are bias‐aware, in the sense that they take possible bias explicitly into account. Their construction shares similarities with that of Anderson–Rubin CSs in exactly identified instrumental variable models, and thereby avoids issues with “delta method” approximations that underlie most commonly used existing inference methods for fuzzy regression discontinuity analysis. Our CSs are asymptotically equivalent to existing procedures in canonical settings with strong identification and a continuous running variable. However, they are also valid under a wide range of other empirically relevant conditions, such as setups with discrete running variables, donut designs, and weak identification.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为模糊设计中的回归不连续参数提出了新的置信集（CSs）。我们的置信集基于局部线性回归，并且是偏差感知的，即它们明确考虑了可能的偏差。它们的构造与恰好识别工具变量模型中的Anderson–Rubin置信集有相似之处，从而避免了模糊回归不连续分析中大多数常用现有推断方法所依赖的“德尔塔方法”近似的问题。在具有强识别和连续运行变量的典型设置中，我们的置信集与现有程序渐近等价。然而，它们在一系列其他经验相关条件下也有效，例如具有离散运行变量、甜甜圈设计和弱识别的设置。

articles.title_en: A Demand Curve for Disaster Recovery Loans
articles.title_cn: 灾难恢复贷款的需求曲线
articles.abstract_en: We estimate and trace a credit demand curve for households that recently experienced damage to their homes from a natural disaster. Our administrative data include over one million applicants to a federal recovery loan program for households. We estimate extensive‐margin demand over a large range of interest rates. Our identification strategy exploits 24 natural experiments, leveraging exogenous, time‐based variation in the program's offered interest rate. Interest rates meaningfully affect consumer demand throughout the distribution of rates. On average, a 1 percentage point increase in the interest rate reduces loan take‐up by 26%. We find a large impact of applicants' credit quality on demand and evidence of monthly payment targeting. Using our estimated demand curve and information on program costs, we find that the program generates an average social surplus of $2900 per borrower.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计并描绘了近期遭受自然灾害房屋损坏的家庭的信贷需求曲线。我们的行政数据包括超过一百万个联邦恢复贷款计划的家庭申请者。我们在广泛的利率范围内估计了广延边际需求。我们的识别策略利用24个自然实验，利用该计划提供的利率的外生、基于时间的变化。利率在整个利率分布中显著影响消费者需求。平均而言，利率每增加1个百分点，贷款接受率降低26%。我们发现申请人的信用质量对需求有重大影响，并存在月度还款目标瞄准的证据。利用我们估计的需求曲线和项目成本信息，我们发现该计划平均每个借款人产生2900美元的社会盈余。

articles.title_en: Identification and Estimation in Many‐to‐One Two‐Sided Matching Without Transfers
articles.title_cn: 无转移多对一双边匹配中的识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: In a setting of many‐to‐one two‐sided matching with nontransferable utilities, for example, college admissions, we study conditions under which preferences of both sides are identified with data on one single market. Regardless of whether the market is centralized or decentralized, assuming that the observed matching is stable, we show nonparametric identification of preferences of both sides under certain exclusion restrictions. To take our results to the data, we use Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate different estimators, including the ones that are directly constructed from the identification. We find that a parametric Bayesian approach with a Gibbs sampler works well in realistically sized problems. Finally, we illustrate our methodology in decentralized admissions to public and private schools in Chile and conduct a counterfactual analysis of an affirmative action policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 在不可转移效用的多对一双边匹配环境中，例如大学招生，我们研究了在单一市场数据下双方偏好可被识别的条件。无论市场是集中还是分散，假设观察到的匹配是稳定的，我们在某些排除限制下证明了双方偏好的非参数识别。为了将我们的结果应用于数据，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟来评估不同的估计量，包括直接从识别中构建的估计量。我们发现，带有吉布斯采样的参数贝叶斯方法在现实规模的问题中表现良好。最后，我们在智利公立和私立学校的分散招生中展示了我们的方法，并对一项平权政策进行了反事实分析。

articles.title_en: Implementation via Information Design in Binary‐Action Supermodular Games
articles.title_cn: 二元行动超模博弈中通过信息设计实施
articles.abstract_en: What outcomes can be implemented by the choice of an information structure in binary‐action supermodular games? An outcome is partially implementable if it satisfies obedience (Bergemann and Morris (2016)). We characterize when an outcome is smallest equilibrium implementable (induced by the smallest equilibrium). Smallest equilibrium implementation requires a stronger sequential obedience condition: there is a stochastic ordering of players under which players are prepared to switch to the high action even if they think only those before them will switch. We then characterize the optimal outcome induced by an information designer who prefers the high action to be played, but anticipates that the worst (hence smallest) equilibrium will be played. In a potential game, under convexity assumptions on the potential and the designer's objective, it is optimal to choose an outcome where actions are perfectly coordinated (all players choose the same action), with the high action profile played on the largest event where that action profile maximizes the average potential.
articles.abstract_cn: 在二元行动超模博弈中，通过选择信息结构可以实施哪些结果？如果一个结果满足服从性（Bergemann和Morris（2016）），则它是部分可实施的。我们刻画了何时一个结果是最小均衡可实施的（由最小均衡诱导）。最小均衡实施需要一个更强的序贯服从条件：存在一个玩家的随机排序，在该排序下，即使玩家认为只有排在他们前面的人会转向高行动，他们也准备转向高行动。然后，我们刻画了偏好高行动被采取但预期最坏（因此最小）均衡将被采取的信息设计者的最优结果。在一个势博弈中，在势函数和设计者目标的凸性假设下，最优选择是选择一个行动完全协调（所有玩家选择相同行动）的结果，其中高行动组合在最大化平均势的最大事件上被采取。

articles.abstract_en: We investigate optimal project management in a setting plagued by an indefinite number of setbacks that are discovered en route to project completion. The contractor can cover up delays in progress due to shirking either by making false claims of setbacks or by postponing the reports of real ones. The sponsor optimally induces work and honest reporting via a soft deadline and a reward for completion that specifies a bonus for early delivery. Late‐stage setbacks trigger randomization between minimally feasible project extension and (inefficient) cancellation. Because extensions may be granted repeatedly, arbitrarily large overruns in schedule and budget are possible after which the project may still be canceled.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在项目完成过程中发现无限数量挫折的环境下的最优项目管理。承包商可以通过虚假声称挫折或推迟报告真实挫折来掩盖因偷懒导致的进度延误。委托人通过软截止日期和规定提前交付奖金的完成奖励来最优地诱导工作和诚实报告。后期挫折会触发在最小可行项目延期和（低效）取消之间的随机化。由于延期可能被反复批准，进度和预算可能出现任意大的超支，之后项目仍可能被取消。

articles.title_en: Equilibrium Grading Policies With Implications for Female Interest in STEM Courses
articles.title_cn: 均衡评分政策及其对女性STEM课程兴趣的影响
articles.abstract_en: We show that stricter grading policies in STEM courses reduce STEM enrollment, especially for women. We estimate a model of student demand for courses and optimal effort choices given professor grading policies. Grading policies are treated as equilibrium objects that in part depend on student demand for courses. Differences in demand for STEM and non‐STEM courses explain much of why STEM classes give lower grades. Restrictions on grading policies that equalize average grades across classes reduce the STEM gender gap and increase overall enrollment in STEM classes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，STEM课程中更严格的评分政策会降低STEM课程的注册率，尤其是对女性而言。我们估计了一个学生课程需求模型以及在给定教授评分政策下的最优努力选择模型。评分政策被视为均衡对象，部分取决于学生对课程的需求。对STEM和非STEM课程需求的差异在很大程度上解释了为什么STEM课程给出的分数较低。对评分政策的限制，使各课程的平均分数相等，缩小了STEM领域的性别差距，并增加了STEM课程的总体注册率。

articles.title_en: Endogenous Information and Simplifying Insurance Choice
articles.title_cn: 内生信息与简化保险选择
articles.abstract_en: In markets with complicated products, individuals may choose how much time and effort to spend understanding and comparing alternatives. Focusing on insurance choice, we find evidence consistent with individuals acquiring more information when there are larger consequences from making an uninformed choice. Building on the rational inattention literature, we develop and estimate a parsimonious demand model in which individuals choose how much to research difficult‐to‐observe characteristics. We use our estimates to evaluate policies that simplify choice. Reducing the number of plans can raise welfare through improved choice as well as savings in information costs. Capping out‐of‐pocket costs generates larger welfare gains than standard models. The empirical model can be applied to other settings to examine the regulation of complex products.
articles.abstract_cn: 在复杂产品的市场中，个体可能选择花费多少时间和精力来理解和比较替代品。聚焦于保险选择，我们发现证据与个体在未被告知选择后果更大时获取更多信息的行为一致。基于理性疏忽文献，我们开发并估计了一个简约的需求模型，其中个体选择研究难以观察特征的程度。我们利用估计结果评估简化选择的政策。减少计划数量可以通过改善选择以及节省信息成本来提高福利。设定自付费用上限比标准模型产生更大的福利收益。该实证模型可应用于其他情境，以检验复杂产品的监管。

articles.title_en: A Comment on: “A Modern Gauss–Markov Theorem”
articles.title_cn: 对《现代高斯-马尔可夫定理》的评论
articles.abstract_en: We show that Theorem 4 in Hansen (2022) applies to exactly the same class of estimators as does the classical Aitken theorem. We furthermore point out that Theorems 5–7 in Hansen (2022) contain extra assumptions not present in the classical Gauss–Markov or Aitken theorem, and thus the former theorems do not contain the latter ones as special cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明Hansen（2022）中的定理4适用于与经典艾特肯定理完全相同的估计量类别。我们进一步指出，Hansen（2022）中的定理5-7包含了经典高斯-马尔可夫或艾特肯定理中不存在的额外假设，因此前者定理并不包含后者作为特例。

articles.title_en: Reply to: Comment on “A Modern Gauss–Markov Theorem”
articles.title_cn: 回复：关于“现代高斯-马尔可夫定理”的评论
articles.abstract_en: This note makes a brief response to Portnoy (2022) and Pötscher and Preinerstorfer (2024), and discusses what instructors should teach about best unbiased estimation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本注释对Portnoy（2022）和Pötscher与Preinerstorfer（2024）作出简要回应，并讨论教师在最佳无偏估计方面应教授的内容。
